headerDisplay: Controls WiFi-connected Coway Airmega purifiers through the IoCare cloud. Coway offers no local API, so an IoCare account is required.
footerDisplay: Accounts that sign in with Google or Apple cannot be used — the plugin needs an email/password login. Coway also forces a password change every 60 days.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to read state from Coway. Each poll is several cloud requests; below 30s is rejected.

exposeLight.title: Expose the panel light as a bulb
